pages.title: Convert PDF to Word for Free: Editable Documents from PDF to DOCX
pages.description: Transform digital PDF text into an editable Word DOCX file directly in your browser. Free, no registration required, with clear limitations.
pages.intro: If you received a contract, report, or notes in PDF and need to revise the content, the first step is to check if you can select the text. Prisma Space extracts that content and prepares a DOCX for further editing in Word or another compatible processor.
pages.details: The converted document prioritizes editable text. Column layouts, complex tables, special typography, or positioned elements may require adjustments after conversion.
steps: Open PDF to Word in Prisma Space and select your digital PDF.
Run the conversion to extract text from its pages.
Download the DOCX and review the format before using it.
pages.tip: Scanned or photo-based PDFs require OCR recognition before this conversion.
faqs: Can I convert a scanned PDF?
This feature works with PDFs that have selectable text; for scanned pages, you need OCR first.
Will it look exactly the same as the PDF?
The goal is to recover editable content. The visual composition may vary and require review.

pages.title: Convert Word to PDF for Free: Save a DOCX as PDF
pages.h1: Convert Word to PDF from Your Browser
pages.description: Prepare your DOCX file to save it as a PDF with the browser's print option. Free and no registration required.
pages.intro: When you need to deliver a document that others can easily open without editing it, the PDF format is often a practical choice. Prisma Space extracts the content from the DOCX and opens a print preview view from which you can choose to Save as PDF.
pages.details: This flow does not directly convert a complex DOCX file while preserving its original design. Tables, jumps, and fonts may appear different; check the preview before saving.
steps: Select your Word DOCX file in the tool.
Open the print preview prepared by Prisma Space.
Choose Save as PDF in the browser dialog and verify the result.
pages.tip: For exact designs, compare the result with the original editor's PDF export.
faqs: Is the PDF downloaded automatically?
No. Prisma prepares a print preview, and you choose Save as PDF in the browser.
Are all font styles respected?
Not necessarily. The content adapts to a printable HTML view, and the layout may change.

pages.title: Merge PDF Files for Free Online: Combine Multiple Documents
pages.h1: Merge PDF Files into One Document
pages.description: Combine multiple PDF files into a downloadable document from your browser, without registration, and without sending files to Prisma Space.
pages.intro: Gathering loose documents is helpful when you need to submit a request, send a dossier, or group notes. In Prisma Space, you can select multiple PDFs and produce a single file in the order you add them.
pages.details: The merge preserves the original pages as part of the final document; it does not fuse paragraphs or modify their text. Before downloading, verify the order of the selected files.
steps: Open Merge PDF and add two or more documents.
Review the file list before executing the merge.
Download the combined PDF and confirm that the pages are in order.
pages.tip: If any of the files is protected or damaged, you may need to obtain a valid copy.
faqs: Is my PDF sent to a server?
This operation is designed to process files locally in the browser.
Can I combine files with different page sizes?
Yes, each page retains its original dimensions within the resulting PDF.

pages.title: Free PDF Splitter: Split and Download ZIP
pages.description: Split a PDF into individual documents by page and download all files in a ZIP. Free, no account required, and local processing.
pages.intro: If you have a multi-page PDF and need to share each sheet separately, manually splitting it can be time-consuming. This tool generates individual PDF files and packages them together for easy download.
pages.details: The result is a ZIP file containing a PDF for each page of the original. If you only need to preserve specific pages, the Extract PDF Pages tool will be more suitable.
steps: Select the PDF you want to split.
Run the automatic page-by-page separation.
Download the ZIP and extract the individual PDFs.
pages.tip: To get a single PDF with specific pages, use the extraction tool instead of splitting everything.
faqs: Will I receive a ZIP or separate files?
You will receive a ZIP file containing the individual PDFs.
Can I split a multi-page PDF?
Yes, as long as your browser has resources to process the document size.

pages.title: Compress PDF for Free: Optimize File Size Without Losing Text
pages.description: Reduce the structural weight of some PDF documents without converting their pages to images. The savings depend on the file.
pages.intro: PDFs can contain duplicate structures or internal objects that can be reorganized. Prisma Space attempts to optimize that structure while maintaining the selectable content of the document.
pages.details: This option does not recompress photographs and does not promise a large reduction in all cases. A PDF composed mainly of images may remain almost as heavy.
steps: Select the PDF document you want to optimize.
Run the optimization of its internal structure.
Compare the size of the downloaded file with the original.
pages.tip: Don't delete the original until you've verified that the result preserves everything you need.
faqs: Is the file size always reduced?
No. The reduction depends on how the PDF is constructed and may be minimal.
Does it lower the image resolution?
This version does not apply advanced compression to the document's photographs.

pages.title: Convert JPG to PDF for Free: Turn Photos into Documents
pages.description: Convert one or multiple JPG photos into a downloadable PDF document. It also supports other compatible image formats.
pages.intro: When documents, receipts, and forms arrive as JPG files, converting them to PDF makes it easy to collect and share them in a simple format. Prisma Space prepares the document using the images you choose.
pages.details: You can add multiple photos in a single operation and select from available page sizes. Before converting, ensure the images are properly oriented and legible.
steps: Open Images to PDF and select your JPG photos.
Choose the page size and confirm your selected images.
Run and download the resulting PDF document.
pages.tip: Converting a blurry JPG to PDF won't recover lost text or details.
faqs: Can I combine multiple JPG photos?
Yes, the tool supports multiple images and generates a PDF with them.
Does the photo become editable text?
No. It's incorporated as an image within the PDF document.

pages.title: Convert PNG to PDF for Free: Turn Images into Documents
pages.description: Convert PNG files to PDF directly in your browser. You can combine multiple images and download a single document.
pages.intro: A graph, screenshot, or design exported as PNG may need to be in PDF format to send or print it. This tool creates a document from the selected images.
pages.details: The PNG is visually embedded in a PDF page. It does not transform the image text into editable text, and transparent elements may appear over the page background.
steps: Select one or multiple PNG files in Images to PDF.
Choose the suitable page size for printing or sharing.
Download the PDF and verify how each image appears.
pages.tip: For very long screenshots, use the option to adjust the page to the image and review the layout.
faqs: Can I convert multiple PNG images to a single PDF?
Yes, you can add multiple images in a single conversion.
Is transparency preserved?
The resulting PDF displays the image over the page; verify how the transparent background is represented.

pages.title: Convert PDF to JPG for Free: Turn Pages into Images
pages.description: Export the pages of a PDF as JPG photographs within a ZIP file. Choose JPG format when opening the tool.
pages.intro: Some platforms only accept images, even if you have the document in PDF. Prisma Space can render the pages as JPG and group the results in a ZIP file.
pages.details: You can select specific pages and adjust the resolution. Unlike extracting embedded images, this operation visually converts each complete page into an image.
steps: Open PDF to Images: The JPG option will be selected.
Upload the PDF and define the pages or resolution if desired.
Run the export and download the ZIP file with the JPG images.
pages.tip: If you need to maintain fine lines and text with maximum clarity, PNG may be a better option than JPG.
faqs: Does it generate one image per page?
Yes, the selected pages are exported separately within a ZIP file.
Can I choose only some pages?
Yes, you can indicate page ranges before converting.

pages.title: Extract Text from PDF for Free: Copy the Content
pages.description: Retrieve selectable text from a digital PDF document to copy or reuse it. Free and from your browser.
pages.intro: When you need to quote a paragraph, take notes, or reuse data from a PDF, copying page by page can be inconvenient. Prisma Space can read the text layers of a digital document and return its content.
pages.details: The extraction preserves words, but not necessarily the same visual organization of the document. Columns, tables, and special characters may require subsequent cleaning.
steps: Select a PDF with selectable text.
Run the text content extraction.
Copy or download the result and verify the line breaks.
pages.tip: For scanned images, extracting text is not enough: you need an OCR process.
faqs: Does it work with a photo saved as a PDF?
No reliably. Pages containing only images require OCR.
Does it maintain the original tables?
The output prioritizes text content, not an exact replica of tables or columns.

pages.title: Extract PDF Pages for Free: Save Only What You Need
pages.description: Select specific pages from a PDF and create a new document with them without altering the original file.
pages.intro: It's common to receive a lengthy document when you only need to present two or three pages. With the extraction tool, you can write a selection like 1, 3, 5-8 and create a reduced PDF that includes those pages.
pages.details: Unlike dividing a complete PDF, here you produce a single document with the pages you've chosen. The remaining pages will not appear in the downloaded copy.
steps: Upload the PDF to Extract Pages.
Indicate the pages you want to keep, for example 1, 3, 5-8.
Run the operation and download the new PDF.
pages.tip: Page numbering starts from page 1 of the file, not from the numbers printed within the document.
faqs: Can I choose non-consecutive pages?
Yes, it supports individual pages and ranges, such as 2, 4-6.
Does the original document get modified?
No. You get an independent PDF copy with the selected pages.

pages.title: Remove PDF Pages for Free and Keep the Rest
pages.description: Delete specific pages from a copy of your PDF while keeping the rest of the pages in a new document.
pages.intro: A PDF may include unwanted covers, blank pages, or pages you don't need to share. Prisma Space allows you to specify the numbers of those pages and create a version that keeps all the rest.
pages.details: This operation does not edit the original file on your device. The downloaded copy will contain the remaining pages in their original order.
steps: Open Remove PDF Pages and select the PDF.
Enter the numbers or page ranges you want to remove.
Run the operation and review the copy before sharing it.
pages.tip: Verify the actual page number of the file: it may not match the printed numbering.
faqs: Can I remove intermediate pages?
Yes, the selection accepts individual pages and ranges.
Can I recover removed pages?
The original PDF does not change, so you can repeat the process with another selection.

pages.title: Rotate PDF for Free: Fix Misoriented Pages
pages.description: Correct the orientation of PDF pages with 90, 180, or 270-degree rotations and download a copy.
pages.intro: If a digitized file appears horizontal, inverted, or sideways, you don't need to rescan it to change the orientation. Prisma Space allows you to rotate PDF pages and generate another version.
pages.details: The tool offers pre-set angles. Check the result after downloading it, especially if the document mixes vertical and horizontal pages.
steps: Select the rotated PDF file.
Choose 90, 180, or 270 degrees based on the correction you need.
Apply the rotation and download the corrected file.
pages.tip: For documents with different orientations, review all pages after the change.
faqs: Will the text in the document be lost?
The rotation changes the page orientation in the PDF; it's not a text-to-image conversion.
Can I rotate to the left?
Yes, a 270-degree rotation is equivalent to a 90-degree rotation to the left.

pages.title: Number PDF Pages for Free: Add Page Numbers
pages.h1: Add Page Numbers to a PDF
pages.description: Place consecutive numbering at the top or bottom of a PDF from your browser.
pages.intro: Reports, academic papers, and files are easier to consult when their pages are numbered. Prisma Space adds numbers to the document pages and generates a downloadable copy.
pages.details: You can choose between top or bottom placement. The numbering is consecutive based on the actual page order of the file, regardless of any existing printed numbers.
steps: Upload your document to Number PDF Pages.
Choose where you want to place the numbering.
Run and verify the position of the numbers in the final PDF.
pages.tip: If your file already has numbers in the same location, they may overlap; review the result.
faqs: Is numbering applied from the first page?
The tool applies consecutive numbering to the document pages.
Can I choose between top and bottom?
Yes, it allows for top or bottom numbering.

pages.title: Free Image Compression: Reduce JPG, PNG, and WebP File Size
pages.h1: Compress an Image Without Installing Software
pages.description: Adjust an image's quality and export a lighter version in JPG or WebP directly from your browser.
pages.intro: High-resolution photos can be too large to send via email or upload to a form. Reducing their export quality can save space while maintaining a suitable appearance for screen viewing.
pages.details: This tool works on an image and allows you to choose a quality level. The final size depends on the original image, its dimensions, and the selected format.
steps: Select the image you want to optimize.
Adjust the quality and choose JPG or WebP as the output format.
Download the file and compare its weight and sharpness with the original.
pages.tip: If you need to preserve transparencies, review the output format before compressing.
faqs: Does compressing an image always reduce its size?
No, it doesn't. It depends on the format, the image's characteristics, and the chosen settings.
Can I adjust the quality?
Yes, the tool allows you to choose a quality level before generating the file.

pages.title: Resize Image for Free: Change Width and Height
pages.description: Modify image dimensions in pixels and optionally preserve the original aspect ratio.
pages.intro: Often a page, form, or social media platform requires images with specific width and height. Resize allows you to adapt the pixel count without needing a full-fledged design editor.
pages.details: Prisma Space offers width and height fields and a checkbox to maintain the aspect ratio. Increasing a small image too much will not invent details that did not exist in the original.
steps: Select your image and view its current dimensions.
Specify the desired width or height and decide if you want to maintain the aspect ratio.
Run and download the image with its new size.
pages.tip: To avoid distorting people or objects, keep the aspect ratio enabled unless you need to stretch the image.
faqs: Can I preserve the aspect ratio of the photo?
Yes, there is an option to preserve the relationship between width and height.
Does resizing improve a blurry image?
No. Changing its pixels does not automatically recover lost detail.

pages.title: Convert PNG to JPG for Free: Image Conversion Tool
pages.description: Convert a PNG image to JPG format directly in your browser. The tool will automatically select JPG as the output format.
pages.intro: The JPG format is ideal for photographs and platforms that do not support PNG files. Prisma Space converts the image to a downloadable JPEG file using browser-based processing.
pages.details: JPG does not support transparency and uses lossy compression. Transparent areas and fine edges may appear different; review the result before deleting the original PNG file.
steps: Open the image converter with JPG selected.
Upload your PNG file and confirm the output format.
Run the conversion and download the JPG image.
pages.tip: If your PNG contains a logo with a transparent background, it may be better to preserve it in PNG or use WebP.
faqs: What happens to the PNG's transparent background?
JPG does not support transparency; the result will display a background without an alpha channel.
Does the conversion change the image dimensions?
The operation's goal is to convert the format, not resize the image.

pages.title: Remove Image Background for Free with Local AI
pages.description: Try background removal to get a transparent PNG image with a model running in your browser.
pages.intro: Separating a person or object from its background can help you create a thumbnail, product card, or composition for social media. Prisma Space offers a local segmentation engine that attempts to preserve the subject and remove the environment.
pages.details: Quality depends on the edges, contrast, lighting, and complexity of the background. The first execution may download the necessary model files to the device.
steps: Open Remove Background and select a compatible image.
Run the processing with the local model.
Review the edges and download the transparent PNG if the result meets your needs.
pages.tip: This feature is in beta. Fine hair, translucent objects, and backgrounds similar to the subject may produce imperfections.
faqs: Do I need to register to remove the background?
The tool can be tried without creating an account; initial model download requires an initial connection.
Will the result always be perfect?
No. The cutout is automatic and may make errors on edges and fine details.

pages.title: Free Online Word and Character Counter
pages.description: Paste your text and calculate words, characters, lines, and approximate reading time without registering.
pages.intro: The word count matters in essays, publications, academic tasks, and descriptions with word limits. Prisma Space analyzes the input text and displays metrics to help you adjust it.
pages.details: Word and character count is a mechanical measure; it doesn't evaluate the quality or originality of the text. You can correct it and re-count as many times as needed.
steps: Open the Word Counter and paste the text.
Run the analysis to view your metrics.
Edit your writing and repeat the count according to the limit you need.
pages.tip: Some platforms count emojis, dashes, or symbols differently; verify the exact limits of your destination.
faqs: Does it also count characters?
Yes, the tool displays statistics for words, characters, and lines.
Do I need to upload a document?
No. You can paste the text you want to analyze directly.

pages.title: Free Secure Password Generator
pages.description: Generate random passwords with security options directly in your browser.
pages.intro: Reusing passwords across services exposes multiple accounts if one of them is compromised. To register a new account, it's best to use a unique, hard-to-guess key and store it in a password manager.
pages.details: Prisma Space includes a local password generator with composition options. Avoid sending or publishing the generated password; consider enabling two-factor authentication when available.
steps: Open the generator and review the security options.
Generate a suitable random password for the service.
Save it in a password manager and use it only for that account.
pages.tip: A strong password does not replace multi-factor authentication or good anti-phishing practices.
faqs: Where should I store my passwords?
It's recommended to use a secure password manager, not a public note or chat.
Can I use the same password across multiple sites?
No, it's not recommended. Generate a unique password for each important account.

pages.title: Free QR Code Generator in PNG
pages.h1: Create QR Codes from Links or Text
pages.description: Generate a downloadable QR code in PNG to share a web address or text.
pages.intro: QR codes are convenient for signs, menus, invitations, or informational cards. You can convert a link into a scannable image that others can open from their phone's camera.
pages.details: Before printing a QR code, ensure the content is final and readable on multiple devices. A static QR code contains the entered data, not an editable link by Prisma.
steps: Open QR Generator and enter the URL or text you want to share.
Generate the QR code and download its PNG image.
Scan it with another phone to verify it works before distributing it.
pages.tip: Don't include secrets or private information in a QR code intended for public spaces.
faqs: Will the QR code stop working if I close Prisma?
A static QR code stores the encoded content in the image and doesn't depend on keeping the page open.
Can I put a link to a web page?
Yes, you can enter a URL and generate a QR code to share it.

pages.title: Free Image-to-Text Conversion with OCR in Spanish | Prisma Space
pages.h1: Convert Image to Text with OCR
pages.description: Extract text from photographs and scanned documents using OCR. Choose Spanish, English, or both languages and review the result before copying it.
pages.intro: If you have a photo of notes, a receipt, or a printed page, rewriting each line can take time. Prisma Space's OCR analyzes the image and recognizes its characters to recover the text content that you can copy and reuse.
pages.details: You can select Spanish, English, or a combination of both languages. On the first execution, the necessary language data is downloaded in the browser. Accuracy depends on the image's clarity, lighting, contrast, and document orientation.
steps: Select a photograph or image containing printed text.
Choose Spanish, English, or both languages in the OCR selector.
Run the recognition, review the detected words, and copy the text.
pages.tip: The OCR may confuse letters, numbers, accents, and columns. Verify names, dates, and numbers against the original image.
faqs: Can I convert a scanned PDF directly?
This tool accepts images. If you have a PDF, convert its pages to images first and then run the OCR.
Does it recognize handwritten text?
It's primarily designed for printed text. Handwritten recognition may be imprecise and requires review.

pages.title: Free PDF Watermark | Prisma Space
pages.h1: Add a Watermark to a PDF
pages.description: Insert a diagonal and semi-transparent text overlay on PDF pages directly from your browser, without replacing the original document.
pages.intro: When sharing a draft, sample, or work document, a watermark helps visually identify its status or origin. Prisma Space allows you to write text and apply it to the pages of a PDF copy.
pages.details: The watermark is represented diagonally and with transparency, so the document content remains legible. You can use a name, an indication like DRAFT, or a reference from your organization. The result is a new downloadable PDF.
steps: Select the PDF file you want to add the watermark to.
Enter the text that will appear as the watermark.
Run the process and review the resulting PDF before sharing it.
pages.tip: A visual watermark does not encrypt the document or prevent someone from copying its content. For confidential information, use suitable access controls.
faqs: Does the watermark appear on all pages?
The tool applies the text to the pages of the processed document.
Does the PDF watermark protect the document with a password?
No. It adds a visual identification, but does not replace encryption or password protection.

pages.title: APA 7, Vancouver, and MLA Reference Generator | Prisma Space
pages.h1: Generate Bibliographic References in APA 7, Vancouver, and MLA
pages.description: Format references with author, year, title, journal or publisher, and DOI. Choose APA 7, Vancouver, or MLA 9 and review the source data.
pages.intro: Preparing an academic work's bibliography requires maintaining a consistent format. This generator organizes the data you input and creates reference versions in three common styles: APA 7, Vancouver, and MLA 9.
pages.details: Add author, year, and title, and include journal, publisher, DOI, or URL when applicable. Prisma Space does not automatically search for publication metadata or verify their accuracy: the result depends on the information you enter.
steps: Enter the authors, year, and publication title.
Add the journal, publisher, DOI, or URL if you have that information.
Select APA 7, Vancouver, or MLA 9 and review the generated reference.
pages.tip: Always consult the official guide for the style required by your university. Review the author order, capitalization, volume, number, pages, and DOI.
faqs: Does the generator search for an article using its DOI?
No. You can enter the DOI or its URL as reference data, but the tool does not automatically query a bibliographic database.
Can I generate Vancouver and APA 7 references?
Yes. The tool displays APA 7, Vancouver, and MLA 9 versions based on the data you provide.

pages.title: Crop Image Online for Free | Prisma Space
pages.description: Crop photos and images by adjusting the width and height of the crop in percentage. Download a copy without installing an editor.
pages.intro: An image may need a more compact frame for a post, a card, or a presentation. This tool crops the image from the center and allows you to define how much of its width and height to keep.
pages.details: You can specify independent percentages for the width and height of the crop. The result is generated in the browser and downloaded as a new file. This version applies a centered crop; it does not yet offer free selection by dragging a frame with the mouse.
steps: Select the photo you want to crop.
Indicate the percentage of width and height you want to keep.
Generate and download the cropped image; check that the frame is suitable.
pages.tip: Since the crop is automatically centered, place the subject near the center before using this version. Keep the original for if you need another frame.
faqs: Can I move the crop frame with the mouse?
This version performs a centered crop using percentages. It does not yet include a free selection frame.
Does the original image change?
No. Prisma generates a cropped copy for download; your original file remains intact.

pages.title: Add a Watermark to an Online Image | Prisma Space
pages.h1: Add a Watermark to an Image
pages.description: Customize and add a text watermark to your photos: choose position, size, color, and opacity, and download the resulting image.
pages.intro: If you publish photos, designs, or work images, you can add a visual signature to indicate authorship or origin. Prisma Space includes a text overlay on the image and allows you to adjust its presentation.
pages.details: Configure the watermark content, its location, pixel size, color, and opacity. You can place it in the corners or center. The tool exports a new image without altering the original file.
steps: Upload the photo or image you want to identify.
Write the watermark and adjust position, size, color, and opacity.
Apply the text and download the image with the watermark included.
pages.tip: A discreet watermark can be more readable and less invasive. Review the result in the actual size at which you will publish the photo.
faqs: Can I add my name or my brand logo?
This tool adds a text watermark. You can write a name, a website, or your brand name; do not insert a logo as a separate file.
Can I change the transparency?
Yes. You can adjust the opacity and choose the text location, size, and color.

pages.title: Create a Photo Collage Online for Free | Prisma Space
pages.description: Combine 2 to 12 photos into a square mosaic. Choose a background and download the composition as a JPG.
pages.intro: A collage allows you to gather multiple photos into a single image to share memories, compare results, or prepare a post. Prisma Space organizes the selected photos into an automatic grid.
pages.details: You can combine between two and twelve images. The system calculates rows and columns based on the number of files, adapts each photo to a square cell, and allows you to choose a white, dark, or light turquoise background. This is not a free composition editor.
steps: Select at least two photos and up to twelve compatible files.
Choose the background color of the mosaic.
Generate the collage and download the composition as a JPG.
pages.tip: Photos are adjusted to square cells and may lose part of their edges. Use images with centered subjects for a more uniform result.
faqs: How many photos can I combine?
You can select two to twelve images in the same composition.
Can I move each photo or change its size separately?
The grid is generated automatically. This version does not allow dragging and manually organizing each photo.

pages.title: Compress Video Online for Free Without Uploading | Prisma Space
pages.description: Reduce the size of MP4, MOV, M4V, WebM, or MKV videos with local processing. Download the result only if it truly weighs less.
pages.intro: Videos recorded with phones and cameras can occupy too much space to send or save. Prisma Space allows you to re-encode a video with a chosen compression level from the browser.
pages.details: You can prioritize a smaller file, a balance, or higher quality. The tool preserves the audio and compares the final size with the original: if the result doesn't weigh less, it doesn't offer a copy that degrades the file without saving space.
steps: Select the video you want to compress.
Choose between small file, balanced, or higher quality.
Wait for the encoding to finish and download the result if its size has been reduced.
pages.tip: Compression may take approximately the same time as the video duration, especially on phones. Keep the tab open and avoid closing the browser during the process.
faqs: Does my video get uploaded to a server?
Compression is designed to run locally in the browser or through native device encoding when available.
Will the video weight always be reduced?
No. If the new encoding doesn't achieve a smaller file, the tool informs of the result and preserves the original.

pages.title: Convert Video to GIF Online for Free | Prisma Space
pages.h1: Convert a Video to an Animated GIF
pages.description: Transform a short video clip into a looping GIF. Select the start second and create a downloadable animation.
pages.intro: An animated GIF is perfect for showing a reaction, gesture, or brief demonstration without sharing a full video. Prisma Space allows you to select a fragment of a video file and convert it into an animation.
pages.details: The tool generates GIFs up to 12 seconds long, with optimized output of approximately 640 pixels wide and 12 frames per second. The multimedia engine downloads on first use and processes the file in the browser.
steps: Upload a compatible video from your device.
Specify the start second and duration of the clip, up to 12 seconds.
Generate the looping GIF and download the resulting file.
pages.tip: GIFs can be heavier than short videos. Use brief clips and avoid scenes with a lot of movement if you're looking for a lightweight file.
faqs: Can I convert a full video to GIF?
The tool is designed for clips up to 12 seconds, not for converting long, complete videos.
Does the GIF have sound?
No. The GIF format contains visual animation, not an audio track.

pages.title: Extract Audio from an Online Video for Free | Prisma Space
pages.description: Separate the audio track from a video file and save it as a WAV file directly in your browser, without uploading the video to Prisma.
pages.intro: Perhaps you recorded an interview, a lecture, or a presentation and need to listen to its audio content only. Extracting the audio allows you to save the track separately for playback or editing.
pages.details: Prisma Space uses a multimedia engine in the browser to separate the audio track from the video and export it as a WAV file. The first use may require downloading processing components; the file duration and size affect the wait time.
steps: Select the video containing the audio you need.
Run the audio track extraction.
Download the WAV file and play it back to verify that the sound is complete.
pages.tip: The result is a WAV file, not MP3. If you need another format, you can open the audio converter in Prisma Space afterwards.
faqs: Can I extract audio from MP4?
Yes, the tool supports compatible video file formats, including MP4 and other common formats.
What format is the audio downloaded in?
The extraction generates a WAV audio file.

pages.title: Cut Video Online for Free by Seconds | Prisma Space
pages.description: Extract a clip from a video by specifying the start second and duration. Download the resulting clip in MP4 format.
pages.intro: You don't always need to send the entire recording to share a specific scene. This tool allows you to indicate when the clip starts and how long it should last.
pages.details: The cut is defined by start seconds and duration, rather than a visual timeline. The multimedia engine runs in the browser and prepares an MP4 file that you can review before sharing.
steps: Select the video you want to cut.
Enter the start second and desired clip duration.
Execute the cut and download the resulting MP4.
pages.tip: Review the result before publishing. Depending on the video's original encoding settings, the cut may not exactly match a frame.
faqs: Can I choose the start and end of the clip?
Yes. Specify the start time and desired duration in seconds.
Do I need to install an editor?
No. Processing occurs in the browser; the first run may download the multimedia engine.

pages.title: Remove Audio from an Online Video for Free | Prisma Space
